name: jstream-streamdeck
description: A Stream Deck plugin that controls JStream over the network: scenes, keyframes, sources, sequences, effects, outputs, channels and hotkey actions, with live key state.

scripts.pack: npm run build && streamdeck validate io.github.jeffmhopkins.jstream.sdPlugin && streamdeck pack io.github.jeffmhopkins.jstream.sdPlugin --output dist --force
